abilitywar.skill.void.skill1.desc: A void tendril drags the target in, then lands a critical punch. Slows for 1s and concusses (blurred vision).
abilitywar.skill.void.skill2.desc: Charge the void in your fist and release it: heavy damage and sends enemies flying. Concussion.
abilitywar.skill.void.skill3.desc: Teleport to the target, throw 4 punches and slam them into the ground. If the target is 3+ blocks above ground, slam immediately for the same damage.
abilitywar.skill.void.skill4.desc: Counter stance. If hit by an attack or skill (not ultimates), negate it, punch the attacker in the face and slam them down. On failure only the guard motion plays.
abilitywar.skill.void.ultimate.desc: Usable when the gauge is full. Summons a black hole that pulls everything in. Captured enemies lose 75% of max health. Players within 10 blocks see the cinematic.
abilitywar.skill.void.passive.desc: Sink into your shadow (invulnerable) and emerge from any shadow you choose: a dark spot or another creature's shadow. Press T again to emerge at the aimed shadow.

ability.abilitywar.dragon.desc: Heir of the Elder Dragon. A melee combo fighter of claws, wings and tail (hard).
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill1.desc: Dash forward and claw twice. The last hit pulls the enemy in front of you and leaves a Dragon Blood mark. Airborne enemies are slashed upward; marked enemies take an empowered last hit.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill2.desc: Spread giant wings to push nearby enemies away, then strike ahead to launch them high. Right after Dragon Claw the wings strike twice. Airborne enemies are pulled in front of you.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill3.desc: Close in instantly: right claw, left claw, tail whip, crossed-claw downstrike. Follows airborne enemies up and slams them down. Bonus hit if Dragon Claw and Wing Strike landed in a row.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill4.desc: Scale-armor counter stance. Negates basic attacks and skills (not ultimates), claws the attacker's face and tail-slams them into the ground. Success lets Fury chain immediately. On failure only the guard pose plays.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.ultimate.desc: Use with a full Dragon Blood gauge. An elder dragon phantom roars and pulls enemies in, you leap into the sky and its breath burns the area. Bonus damage on marked enemies, brief super armor. While transformed, usable as a finisher with any remaining gauge.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.passive.desc: Hold T with a full Dragon Blood gauge. Claws, wings, scales and glowing patterns grow, fire afterimages trail your movement, basic attacks become claw strikes and some skills are empowered. Ends when the gauge runs out.
abilitywar.ult.dragon.title: 古龍降臨
abilitywar.ult.dragon.subtitle: Advent of the Elder Dragon
